title: Zero and first conditionals
titleVi: Câu điều kiện loại 0 và loại 1
summary: Nói về quy luật tất yếu và khả năng thực tế trong tương lai — nền tảng để lập luận nguyên nhân - kết quả trong Task 2.
whyItMatters: Task 2 yêu cầu bạn nêu hệ quả: *If governments subsidise childcare, more parents can return to work.* Câu điều kiện loại 1 là cấu trúc gọn nhất để làm việc đó, còn loại 0 diễn tả quy luật. Lỗi `if ... will` là lỗi phổ biến nhất và dễ tránh nhất trong cả hai loại.

sections.heading: Zero conditional: general truths and automatic results
body: The zero conditional is **if/when + present simple, present simple**. It states a rule that is always true: cause and effect, scientific fact, or habitual consequence.
**If** and **when** are interchangeable here because the result always follows: *If you heat ice, it melts* = *When you heat ice, it melts*.
In academic writing, this is the structure of definitions and mechanisms: *If demand exceeds supply, prices rise.*

examples.right: If you heat ice, it melts.
examples.note: Scientific fact — both clauses in the present simple.

examples.right: When public transport is reliable, car use tends to fall.
If a country invests in education, productivity usually improves.
examples.wrong: If a country will invest in education, productivity usually improves.

sections.heading: First conditional: a real possibility in the future
body: The first conditional is **if + present simple, will + base verb**. It describes a future situation that is genuinely possible, and its likely result.
The result clause can also use **can**, **may**, **might**, **must** or an imperative instead of **will**: *If you finish early, you can leave.* / *If it rains, take an umbrella.*
The **if** clause keeps the present simple even though the meaning is future. This is the single most tested rule in the whole conditional system.

examples.right: If the city builds more cycle lanes, traffic congestion will fall.
If you finish the survey today, you can submit it tomorrow.
If tuition fees rise again, many students may defer their studies.
If the government raises the tax, small businesses will struggle.
examples.wrong: If the government will raise the tax, small businesses will struggle.
examples.note: Sau **if** dùng present simple, không dùng **will**.

sections.heading: Unless, provided that, as long as and in case
body: **unless** means *if not*: *Unless the council acts, air quality will worsen.* Never use **unless** with another negative — *unless you don't study* is a double negative.
**provided that** and **as long as** state a condition that must be met: *The scheme will work provided that funding continues.*
**in case** is not a condition — it means *because something might happen*: *Take a copy in case the file is lost.*

rows: If it rains, the event moves indoors.
Unless it rains, the event stays outside.
The plan works provided that funding continues.
Take a copy in case the file is lost.

sections.heading: Tense and punctuation rules
body: No **will** in the **if** clause. If you need to show completion, use the present perfect: *If you have finished, you may leave.*
When the **if** clause comes first, use a comma. When it comes second, no comma is needed: *Traffic will fall if the city builds more cycle lanes.*
The zero conditional never takes **will** in either clause, because it describes what always happens, not a prediction.

examples.right: If you have completed the form, hand it to the officer at the desk.
examples.note: Present perfect in the **if** clause for completion.

examples.right: Traffic will fall if the city builds more cycle lanes.
examples.note: No comma when the **if** clause comes second.

examples.right: Unless the council acts, air quality will worsen.
examples.wrong: Unless the council doesn't act, air quality will worsen.
examples.note: **Unless** đã mang nghĩa phủ định — không thêm **not**.

sections.heading: Conditionals as an argument tool in Task 2
body: Use the first conditional to spell out a policy's likely effect: *If governments subsidise childcare, more parents will be able to return to full-time work.*
Use the zero conditional to state a general principle before applying it: *If wages stagnate while prices rise, households inevitably cut spending.*
Do not overuse conditionals. Two or three well-placed ones per essay create logical structure; eight make the argument sound hypothetical and weak.

examples.right: If governments subsidise childcare, more parents will be able to return to full-time work.
examples.note: Policy consequence in a Task 2 body paragraph.

examples.right: If wages stagnate while prices rise, households inevitably cut spending.
Provided that the funding is ring-fenced, the programme should succeed.
examples.note: A condition that must hold for the proposal to work.

commonMistakes.wrong: If it will rain tomorrow, we will cancel the trip.
commonMistakes.right: If it rains tomorrow, we will cancel the trip.
commonMistakes.why: Mệnh đề `if` không dùng `will`, dù nghĩa là tương lai. Đây là lỗi số một của người học Việt Nam với câu điều kiện.

commonMistakes.wrong: Unless you don't study, you will fail the exam.
commonMistakes.right: Unless you study, you will fail the exam.
commonMistakes.why: `Unless` đã có nghĩa 'nếu không', nên không thêm `not` — nếu không sẽ thành phủ định kép.

commonMistakes.wrong: When you heat ice, it will melt.
commonMistakes.right: When you heat ice, it melts.
commonMistakes.why: Quy luật tự nhiên dùng câu điều kiện loại 0 với `present simple` ở cả hai mệnh đề, không dùng `will`.

commonMistakes.wrong: If you will have finished the report, send it to me.
commonMistakes.right: If you have finished the report, send it to me.
commonMistakes.why: Trong mệnh đề `if`, thì hoàn thành dùng `present perfect`, không dùng `will have`.

commonMistakes.wrong: If I study hard, I would pass the exam.
commonMistakes.right: If I study hard, I will pass the exam.
commonMistakes.why: Khả năng thực tế trong tương lai dùng câu điều kiện loại 1 với `will`. `Would` thuộc câu điều kiện loại 2 (không có thật).

ieltsTips: Dùng câu điều kiện loại 1 để triển khai hệ quả chính sách trong Task 2: `If the government invests in public transport, congestion will fall.`
Dùng câu điều kiện loại 0 để nêu nguyên lý chung trước khi áp dụng vào lập luận cụ thể.
Nhớ quy tắc dấu phẩy: mệnh đề `if` đứng trước thì có dấu phẩy, đứng sau thì không.
Hạn chế dùng quá ba câu điều kiện trong một bài Task 2; lạm dụng khiến lập luận nghe giả định và thiếu dứt khoát.

exercises.question: If the city ___ more cycle lanes, congestion will fall.
options: will build
builds
built
is building
exercises.explanation: Mệnh đề **if** của câu điều kiện loại 1 dùng **present simple**.

exercises.question: Which sentence states a general truth correctly?
options: When you heat ice, it will melt.
When you heat ice, it melts.
When you will heat ice, it melts.
When you heat ice, it melted.
exercises.explanation: Quy luật tự nhiên (loại 0) dùng **present simple** ở cả hai mệnh đề.

exercises.question: ___ the council acts, air quality will continue to worsen.
options: Unless
If
Provided that
In case
exercises.explanation: **Unless** = nếu không; nghĩa câu cần 'trừ khi hội đồng hành động'.

exercises.question: Which sentence uses 'unless' correctly?
options: Unless you don't study, you will fail.
Unless you study, you will fail.
If you don't study, you will not fail.
Unless you study, you won't fail.
exercises.explanation: **Unless** đã mang nghĩa phủ định nên không thêm **not**; nghĩa đúng là 'nếu bạn không học, bạn sẽ trượt'.

exercises.question: Which sentence uses the correct conditional for a real future possibility?
options: If governments will subsidise childcare, more parents return to work.
If governments subsidise childcare, more parents will return to work.
If governments subsidised childcare, more parents will return to work.
If governments subsidise childcare, more parents would return to work.

exercises.question: If tuition fees ___ (rise) again, many students may defer their studies.
exercises.explanation: Mệnh đề **if** dùng present simple dù nghĩa tương lai.

exercises.question: Unless the government ___ (invest) in rural clinics, healthcare access will remain unequal.
exercises.explanation: **Unless** + present simple, chủ ngữ số ít nên thêm **-s**.

exercises.question: Take a copy of the form ___ the original is lost.
exercises.explanation: **In case** diễn tả 'phòng khi điều gì xảy ra', khác với điều kiện thuần tuý.

exercises.question: If you ___ (finish) the survey today, you can submit it tomorrow.
exercises.explanation: Có thể dùng present simple hoặc present perfect trong mệnh đề **if**; kết quả dùng **can**.

exercises.question: The scheme will work ___ funding continues.
exercises.hint: liên từ chỉ 'với điều kiện là'
exercises.explanation: **Provided that** nêu điều kiện bắt buộc để kết quả xảy ra.
